detail.readme: # AI Agent Deep Dive **English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) ## Quick Links PDF reports: - New: **Hermes Agent Source Code Deep Dive** - Claude Code: [ai-agent-deep-dive-v2.1.pdf](./ai-agent-deep-dive-v2.1.pdf), including the new Chapter 8: Memory System. - Claude Code: [ai-agent-deep-dive-v2.pdf](./ai-agent-deep-dive-v2.pdf). ## Educational Agent Code This repository also includes a **minimal Python agent built for learning**, demonstrating how to structure the core components of an AI agent. ### Where to Find the Code - Agent core: [`src/agt/agent.py`](./src/agt/agent.py) - CLI entry point: [`src/agt/cli.py`](./src/agt/cli.py) - Learning materials: [`docs/`](./docs) ### Project Goals This minimal agent is designed for educational use, with an emphasis on: - Keeping the structure clear. - Avoiding unnecessary engineering complexity. - Keeping the core code small and easy to explore. - Focusing on the agent loop, a Fake LLM interface, skill discovery, and the CLI skeleton. ### Running the Minimal Agent The project uses Poetry to manage dependencies. #### 1. Install Dependencies ```bash poetry install ``` #### 2. Run the Agent CLI ```bash poetry run agt "Hello" ``` #### 3. List Available Skills ```bash poetry run agt --skills-dir ./skills --list-skills ``` ### Current Implementation The current version is a **minimal educational implementation**. It does not yet connect to a real remote model API. It includes a replaceable Fake LLM that returns a test response in streamed text chunks for each user input. This keeps the model integration separate from the agent itself: connecting a real model later only requires replacing the LLM call layer, rather than rewriting the agent.
detail.readme_zh: # AI Agent Deep Dive [English](./README.md) | **简体中文** ## Quick Links PDF 下载 / PDF Report: - 新增《Hermes Agent 源码深度解析》，在我的知识星球 [矩阵之外](https://t.zsxq.com/v10jO) - ClaudeCode [ai-agent-deep-dive-v2.1.pdf](./ai-agent-deep-dive-v2.1.pdf) 新增第八章：记忆系统 - ClaudeCode [ai-agent-deep-dive-v2.pdf](./ai-agent-deep-dive-v2.pdf) ## Teaching Agent Code 这个仓库现在还包含一个**教学用的最小 Python Agent 项目**，用于演示一个 AI Agent 的核心结构应该怎么组织。 ### 核心代码位置 - Agent 核心代码：[`src/agt/agent.py`](./src/agt/agent.py) - CLI 入口：[`src/agt/cli.py`](./src/agt/cli.py) - 教学文档：[`docs/`](./docs) ### 这个教学项目的定位 这个最小 Agent 项目是为了教学而设计的，特点是： - 尽量保持结构清晰 - 尽量减少不必要的工程复杂度 - 所有核心代码集中在一个很小的范围内，方便学习 - 当前重点放在：Agent 主循环、Fake LLM 接口、Skills 发现、CLI 骨架 ### 如何运行最小 Agent 本项目使用 Poetry 管理依赖。 #### 1. 安装依赖 ```bash poetry install ``` #### 2. 运行最小 Agent CLI ```bash poetry run agt "你好" ``` #### 3. 查看 Skills ```bash poetry run agt --skills-dir ./skills --list-skills ``` ### 当前实现说明 当前版本是一个**教学型最小实现**，还没有接入真实远程模型 API。 目前内置的是一个可替换的 Fake LLM： - 用户输入什么 - 它就会用流式文本块的方式返回一个测试响应 这样做的目的，是为了让后续接入真实模型时，只需要替换 LLM 调用层，而不需要重写整个 Agent 主体。
